Overview.p: A bucket policy is a JSON resource policy attached to a bucket. It can grant or deny access to accounts, roles, services or the public.
House rules written on the locker door.
A policy denies any request that is not over HTTPS and allows one partner account read access.

items: S3 evaluates it with IAM policies
The result is allow or deny

items: Can a bucket policy allow another account?
Yes, by naming the account or role as Principal.
IAM allows but the bucket policy denies?
Access is denied. Explicit deny wins.
